Bhumi Amla Powder Exporter: Bhumi Amla Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Bhumi amla powder is made from the whole Phyllanthus niruri plant, dehydrated and milled for herbal, supplement and tea manufacturers. Tradenest Naturals is a bhumi amla powder exporter and bulk manufacturer in Surat, India. The herb is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and herbal formulations. We supply it as a plain, single-herb powder with a consistent specification.

Why Choose Our Manufacturing Facility?

Our production follows documented food-safety practices in an FSSAI licensed facility. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. We clean, dehydrate and mill the whole plant under hygienic conditions. Moisture and mesh are checked on each batch. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Key Specifications of Our Wholesale Herb Powder

  • Botanical Name: Phyllanthus niruri
  • Particle Size: 80-100 mesh for smooth blending
  • Moisture Content: Below 7% to limit caking
  • Purity: Single-herb powder with no additives

Applications Across Multiple Industries

Our bulk bhumi amla powder supplier service supports several sectors. Supplement companies use the powder in capsules and herbal blends. Hair care brands add it to herbal hair oils and powder washes, where it has a traditional place. Tea and beverage brands blend the fine powder into herbal teas and powder mixes.

Packaging Options and Shelf-Life Stability

We pack bhumi amla powder wholesale orders in food-grade, moisture-barrier materials. Choose from export drums, HDPE containers or custom private label pouches. Each batch is sealed with care. Shelf life is 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for a bhumi amla powder exporter? The MOQ is 5 Kg. Private label runs with custom packaging are quoted separately. What are the typical lead times for export orders? Lead time depends on order size, packaging and destination. We confirm it with each quotation. How do I request a sample or price quote? Contact our sales team through our website for a bhumi amla powder price per kg quote and to request product samples.
